name: reject-without-a-request-sends-no
description: In built-in mode with no permission request waiting, Reject sends the word No to the harness as an ordinary user turn, logged as the person's own message.
reason: Claude asks its questions in the reply, so Reject answers them in words. Only a waiting permission request (built-in) or remote mode (Escape) turns Reject into something else.
source: DESIGN.md v1.0 '○ → reject: "No" as a user turn'; AppState.reject

script.reason: Nothing is waiting for an answer, so Reject says No.
